summary: Rankin County, MS 100 ft Aermotor tower, NHLR-registered 2022 as US 1660; all stairs intact on a 7/9/22 visit; the Mississippi Forestry Commission has vacated the site.

facts.design: 100 ft Aermotor tower with a straight internal staircase of 14 landings and 15 flights
facts.status_note: Standing with all stairs intact at the register visit recorded as 7/9/22; the register says the Mississippi Forestry Commission has vacated the site

events.note: Registered July 10, 2022 as US 1660, MS 26; nominated by Jason Johns
Register site visit recorded as 7/9/22; all stairs intact
As of the register visit, the Mississippi Forestry Commission had vacated the site; the register does not say when

evidence.supports: 100 ft Aermotor tower with straight internal staircase; the register's only narrative, with no staffing or fire history on the page

evidence.supports: 14 landings and 15 flights, all stairs intact

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR register page and the OSM node were usable. Two web searches found nothing on the tower's history or staffing. A cached Forest Lookouts page named 'Shiloh' (data/raw/eastern_us_lookouts/shiloh.html) is a Maryland tower and was not used. The register's visit date 7/9/22 is read as July 9, 2022 (US date order); the story gives it as written to avoid ambiguity. Current access and condition are unknown since the 2022 visit.
